name: UT Salesforce
description: Unit tests of every Salesforce command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

variables.name: ut_dir
variables.description: Folder with the test data (files, workbooks, fixtures).

variables.name: standin_url
variables.description: Address of the local stand-in that imitates outside services.

variables.name: ut_report
variables.description: One line per case: PASS or FAIL, the command and the case.

args.title: 0. About this agent

args.text: Unit tests of every Salesforce command against the local stand-in (made-up records, made-up token from the vault): each case shows the command in use and checks its result.

args.message: Unit test agent UT Salesforce started

steps.description: 0. About this agent

args.title: 1. ooa.salesforce/authenticate - client credentials on a custom sign-in site

args.text: Authenticate gets an access token from the connected app (client credentials) and keeps it, with the instance address Salesforce gives back, as the Salesforce session for the next steps. Checks the instance address and that a token came back.

args.message: the instance address: expected contains "/biz/salesforce", got ${sf_instance}

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.message: the access token: expected notEmpty , got ${sf_token}

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed

args.value: ${ut_report}PASS  ooa.salesforce/authenticate: client credentials on a custom sign-in site

children.description: Add a PASS line to the report
Run the command and check what it gave back

args.value: ${ut_report}FAIL  ooa.salesforce/authenticate: client credentials on a custom sign-in site: ${ut_err}

children.description: Add a FAIL line with the reason

steps.description: 1. ooa.salesforce/authenticate - client credentials on a custom sign-in site

args.title: 2. ooa.salesforce/query - SOQL with a parameter, in the session

args.text: Query (SOQL) runs a query and returns every matching record as a table; :ind is filled in safely from parameters. No address or token on the step: the session gives them. Checks two Retail accounts.

args.soql: SELECT Id, Name FROM Account WHERE Industry = :ind ORDER BY Name

else.description: Stop the case: the check failed
